title: STORY BEHIND: George Daniels and the co-axial escapement
hook: A watchmaker solved a 200-year-old problem, then gave the answer to Omega
why: Tension hook with a person who changed watchmaking. Avoids Genta, Breguet and Wilsdorf (already posted or used). Launch date and the Daniels story are unverified; no On This Day check for 22 November was run.
